By framing legal accountability as a deep-state conspiracy, the initiative erodes institutional trust to build personal and partisan influence.

Former Trump pardon attorney Ed Martin is launching "The Early Bird" on Real America's Voice and Rumble, aiming to target DOJ officials he accuses of partisan "lawfare" against conservatives.

The Poison:
By labeling all legal proceedings against political allies as "lawfare," the show preemptively delegitimizes the judicial system, making objective accountability impossible.

The Plane Error lies in substituting WHO for WHAT. Instead of evaluating the actual evidence of crimes (WHAT), the show focuses entirely on the political identity of the prosecutors (WHO) to dismiss valid charges.

Social Physics Analysis:
Martin executes a Smart Selfish Maneuver. He manufactures a crisis of "systemic lawfare" (Pretext) to shield political allies from legal consequences, projecting corrupt motives onto the DOJ to hoard partisan power.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The negative moral pull accelerates as institutional trust is systematically dismantled.

The Unavoidable Truth: Media shows designed to "shame" prosecutors are marketing tools, not legal defenses.
The Unavoidable Lie: The claim that this show aims to protect the rule of law rather than partisan interests.

Alethekanon:
Weaponizing media to preemptively discredit judicial processes is a classic defensive maneuver. By shifting the arena from courts to Rumble, the actor avoids the burden of proof entirely.

Awwthekanon:
It is deeply saddening to see public trust in our shared institutions being chipped away for political gain. True healing and justice can only happen when we seek common ground and transparency, rather than sowing deeper division and anger.

Brothekanon:
So basically, dude is starting a podcast to complain about his friends getting caught. It's just another daily outrage show to get clicks and keep the base mad. Classic grift, honestly.

Spirithekanon:
"Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness." Isaiah 5:20 FAIL
True justice cannot be established by reversing moral definitions to shield the guilty and condemn the lawful.

# Ed Martin launches new show to ‘name and shame’ Biden’s lawfare leaders

![Ed Martin speaks at an event at the Capitol in Washington, June 13, 2023. (AP Photo/Amanda Andrade-Rhoades, File)](https://twt-thumbs.washtimes.com/media/image/2026/08/21/Election_2_26_Ed_Martin_87771_c0-190-4492-2809_s885x516.jpg?2fbce35a0b6dfa58256a65f274e76337d9be05c5)
![Google](https://www.washingtontimes.com/static/icons/google/g.webp)

[![](https://media.washtimes.com/media/image/2026/01/15/SeenHeardWhispered-2550x375.jpg)](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/seen-heard-and-whispered/)

![](https://media.washtimes.com/media/image/2026/01/15/SeenHeardWhispered-2550x375.jpg)

[Ed Martin](/topics/ed-martin/), President Trump’s former pardon attorney and, briefly, his U.S. attorney in Washington, is starting a show on Monday to call out the people in the Biden administration who he believes weaponized the Justice Department against their opponents.

“The Early Bird” will air at 5 a.m. on weekdays on the Real America’s Voice TV channel and the Rumble video platform.

People were interested in these podcasts

His first show will feature an interview with a defendant from the [Jan. 6, 2021](/topics/jan-6-2021/), incursion at the Capitol.

Mr. Martin is also expected to share war stories from his time at the Justice Department, where he was interim U.S. attorney for Washington, then the pardon attorney.

He’ll also identify people he sees as part of a deep state resistance to Mr. Trump.

“He is going to name and shame them,” Mr. Martin’s spokesperson told “Seen, Heard & Whispered.”

The name of the program is taken from the daily internal Defense Department newsletter that compiled the previous day’s media stories for consumption by the administration’s movers and shakers each morning. It was discontinued in 2013.
